project_metadata.name: Personal Portfolio Website
project_metadata.description: A personal website built from scratch to showcase portfolio and skills.

tasks.details: Created root folder, index.html, style.css, and script.js.
Implemented Header, Hero Section, About, Projects, and Footer using semantic tags.
Applied universal selector (*) to remove default browser margins/padding.
Used Flexbox for navigation and Grid for the project gallery.
Added media queries (@media) for mobile and tablet views.
Implemented JS toggle to switch CSS classes for dark theme.
Added JS event listeners for anchor links to scroll smoothly to sections.

critical_incident.description: Git Push triggered multiple expensive builds on Netlify, consuming free tier credits rapidly.
critical_incident.solution: Decoupled GitHub from Netlify and switched to Manual CLI Builds.

tasks.details: Disconnected GitHub from Netlify to stop auto-builds.
Installed netlify-cli globally to enable local builds.
Established new workflow: 'npm run build' -> 'netlify deploy --prod'.

future_roadmap.notes: Add meta tags and OpenGraph data.
